official_site: https://iaq.na.panasonic.com (Panasonic North America Indoor Air Quality / ventilation; na.panasonic.com is the corporate HubSpot site with no product catalog)
catalog_endpoint: https://iaq.na.panasonic.com/sitemap.xml (456 URLs; 151 under /ventilation/ or /smart-controls/) + HubSpot site search JSON https://iaq.na.panasonic.com/_hcms/search?term=<SKU>&limit=N
est_products: ~151 official product/series pages (ventilation + smart controls); Buy Rite Electric Panasonic collection has 144 products
sku_format_match: yes - model numbers on official pages and in hubfs image filenames use the same format (FV-0510VSC1, VTX-DEDPV, FV-1115VKL3). Official pages are per series and may list several models; HubSpot search is fuzzy (tokenizes 'FV'), so match by model regex on page content. Distributor Buy Rite Electric matched 12 of 12 samples exactly on variant.sku.

alternatives.name: Buy Rite Electric
alternatives.notes: All 12 samples matched exactly on variant.sku; all 144 products have images. Many images are Panasonic marketing assets (IAQ2xxxxWEB filenames); some are low-res (e.g. *_500x*) or screenshots (FV-CMVK3 -> Screenshot_87_...png).

alternatives.name: SupplyHouse.com
alternatives.notes: Carries FV-0511VH1 per web search, but /products.json probe returned Cloudflare challenge (403). Not usable from here.

recommended_strategy: Primary for matching: pull buyriteelectric.com/collections/panasonic/products.json?limit=250 and match variant.sku exactly (12/12 samples). For higher-quality official images, crawl the ~151 /ventilation/ and /smart-controls/ URLs from iaq.na.panasonic.com/sitemap.xml (1 req/sec), extract hubfs image URLs (strip ?width query to get original) and prefer images whose filename contains the exact model number; use official image when found, else Buy Rite image.
